name: delivered context
wording: a cratylus bounded context shipped read-only as the practice a project's agents work by, never part of the project's conceptual model: shown apart from the project's contexts, outside its context map, and read first by a fresh session, upstream always before downstream; a project holding that context itself reads its own in its place
reason: The lead asked which wins when a project holds an upstream delivered context itself but not the one downstream of it: upstream before downstream does, since a term must be read before the terms built on it; the project's own copy takes the delivered one's place in that order.
